profile.headline: Technical Lead | Senior Software Engineer | .NET, Blazor, ASP.NET Core, Enterprise Architecture | AI-Assisted Development
profile.summary:
With over 7 years of experience as a Senior Developer at MEMC, LLC, I specialize in designing, implementing, and supporting desktop applications, websites, and server components using .NET technologies, Oracle, and PostgreSQL. My work also involves utilizing RabbitMQ and Java libraries to develop robust and efficient server applications tailored to organizational needs.  

Committed to delivering innovative and scalable solutions, I focus on leveraging modern technologies to drive seamless functionality and integration across systems. My mission is to contribute to impactful projects that enhance operational efficiency and align with the goals of MEMC, LLC, while maintaining a strong emphasis on problem-solving, programming, and excellent written communication.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Design, Implement & support multiple desktop applications, websites and components using .net technologies (.net core, .net framework) on both Oracle & PostgreSQL to utilize RabbitMQ library. I also develop & support various server applications, components using Java libraries.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
2015 – 05/2018: Develop & Support an enterprise solution (using .NET 4.5 and SQL server database) which handles IRS 1094/1095-B submission & status update. This solution takes care of thousands of submission and about half-million 1095-B forms annually.   

Develop, Enhance and support multiple data services: Using different technics to provide data access to different data sources such as Oracle, SQL server, My SQL, IBM DB2, IBM UNIDATA, CGI... Those serve as unified data source for many ZAS systems: different websites, IVR, Reporting services…

Develop and support many SSIS packages which integrate with different sources (Oracle, SQL server, My SQL, IBM DB2…)

Enhance and support a .NET enterprise solution which provides ZAS clients accesses to various areas: Rule Engine, Contribution Accounting, Welfare Eligibility, Pension Accrual, Correspondence…

April 2010 – November 2011: Studied and Utilized Blaze Advisor to implement business layers which handle welfare eligibility rules.

positions.title: Software Engineer & System Architect
positions.description:
Designed & implemented various major modules (using .NET framework 2.0, 3.5 and Oracle database) such as Contribution Accounting, Welfare Eligibility, Rule Engine, Pension Accrual, COBRA, MS document template correspondences…..Those are multi-tier solutions from window UI, websites, web services, scheduled jobs… 

Designed & implemented a web application using ASP.NET, VB.NET and MS SQL Server for SIRTex Medical Inc.

Designed & implemented a web-based issue tracking system which is used by Medmark Inc. and Zenith Administrator, a complete configurable solution from business templates to notification templates.

positions.title: Software Engineer , Project manager
positions.description:
Designed and developed a client-server application to manage sale & presentation for Bayer Vietnam using MS Access & MS Visual Studio 6.

Developed a client-server application using MS Visual Studio 6 and Oracle database to support Chicago Laborer Welfare & Pension Funds in Contribution Accounting area.
